name: ST通葡
current_thesis: ST通葡仍是高风险困境资产，葡萄酒本体有一定品牌和毛利基础，但合并口径主要受低毛利电商、历史违规担保、诉讼预计负债、现金流持续为负和ST事项约束。2026-07-20股价2.51元对应约11.39亿元市值和约5.2倍PB，明显高于资产法、EPV和相对估值可支持的0.45-0.85元合理区间，当前缺乏安全边际。

position_plan.condition: price <= 0.45 and no new delisting, audit, internal-control, litigation or liquidity deterioration
position_plan.action: research-only starter position after fresh review

position_plan.condition: 0.45 < price <= 0.65 and half-year/quarterly reports confirm cash-flow improvement
position_plan.action: watchlist only or very small tracking position

position_plan.condition: price > 0.65 or unresolved ST/litigation/cash-flow risks persist
position_plan.action: avoid new buying and keep position at zero

price_triggers.reason: enters conservative research buy zone based on asset and EPV cross-check
enters strong distress-value zone if no new delisting or liquidity risk appears
above fundamental fair value range; do not chase and reduce if held
pricing becomes mostly event/speculation driven rather than fundamental value

review_triggers.reason: review 2026 half-year report, actual loss, operating cash flow, ST and litigation progress
review 2026 third-quarter report and whether cash burn/expected liabilities stabilize
review 2026 annual report, audit opinion, internal control, delisting and other-risk-warning status

notes: 2026-07-20 close was 2.51 CNY from Tencent/Sina quote snapshots; total market capitalization was approximately 1.139 billion CNY.
2025 annual report disclosed revenue of 682.65 million CNY, net loss attributable to parent of 83.42 million CNY and operating cash flow of -409.23 million CNY.
2026 Q1 report disclosed revenue of 190.12 million CNY, net loss attributable to parent of 11.52 million CNY, operating cash flow of -71.78 million CNY and parent equity of 220.24 million CNY.
2026 half-year pre-loss announcement data was sourced from announcement aggregation because direct original PDF access was limited; confidence is medium.
Key unresolved risks are ST status, historical illegal guarantee, litigation execution, expected liabilities, frozen assets, weak operating cash flow and possible refinancing dilution.
